facts.fact: Municipal access information routes Shinkansen journeys through Okayama Station and then localJR services to Kurashiki.
The city gives approximately17minutes by localJR between Okayama and Kurashiki; this is an orientation rather than a live timetable.
facts.excerpt: It takes approximately 17 minutes from Okayama Station to Kurashiki Station using the local JR line.

facts.fact: Kojima and Tamashima are separate onward sectors; do not fold them into the compact Bikan walking route.
